summary.text: A 17-year-old male with IgE-mediated peanut allergy and eczema presented with acute dysphagia after eating beef. Esophagram showed a complete mid-esophageal food impaction, which was removed endoscopically; EREFS was 4 and biopsies showed only rare (<5) eosinophils with basal cell hyperplasia and intercellular edema.
